In this work, we study two paradigms of reader modules, i.e. extractive  and generative  readers. The extractive reader extracts contiguous spans from the retrieved passages whereas the generative reader sequentially decodes the answer string which might not be contained in the retrieved passages.
We follow the standard evaluation protocol and use exact match (EM) as the evaluation metric.
